Arian Kabashi is a professional footballer born on **June 20, 1996**, in **Switzerland**. He is of **Kosovar Albanian** descent and has represented both **Switzerland** and **Kosovo** at the international level. Here’s a detailed overview of his career and background:

---

### **Early Life & Background**
- **Full Name:** Arian Kabashi
- **Date of Birth:** June 20, 1996
- **Place of Birth:** Winterthur, Switzerland
- **Nationality:** Swiss (also eligible for Kosovo)
- **Position:** **Defensive Midfielder / Central Midfielder**
- **Height:** ~1.80 m (5 ft 11 in)
- **Foot:** Right

Kabashi grew up in Switzerland and began his youth career in local clubs before joining **FC Winterthur**, his hometown team.

---

### **Club Career**
#### **1. FC Winterthur (2013–2016)**
- Kabashi progressed through Winterthur’s youth academy and made his **senior debut** in the **Swiss Challenge League (2nd division)** in the **2013–14 season**.
- He became a regular in the first team, playing as a defensive midfielder.
- **Total Appearances:** ~50+ (all competitions)

#### **2. FC Schaffhausen (2016–2017)**
- In **2016**, he moved to **FC Schaffhausen**, another Swiss Challenge League side.
- Played a key role in midfield but struggled with injuries.
- **Total Appearances:** ~20

#### **3. FC Wil (2017–2019)**
- Joined **FC Wil 1900** in **2017**, continuing in the Challenge League.
- Established himself as a **box-to-box midfielder**, known for his **tackling, passing, and work rate**.
- **Total Appearances:** ~50

#### **4. FC Vaduz (2019–2021)**
- Signed with **FC Vaduz** (Liechtenstein’s top club, playing in the Swiss Challenge League).
- Helped the team compete in the **Swiss Cup** and **Europa League qualifiers**.
- **2019–20:** Played in **Europa League qualifiers** (vs. **Breidablik & Eintracht Frankfurt**).
- **Total Appearances:** ~60

#### **5. FC Thun (2021–2022)**
- Moved to **FC Thun** in the **Swiss Super League** (top tier) in **2021**.
- Struggled with **injuries and limited playing time**, making only **a few appearances**.
- **Total Appearances:** ~10

#### **6. FC Wil (Return, 2022–2023)**
- Rejoined **FC Wil** in **2022** after his contract with Thun expired.
- Played a **leadership role** in midfield but faced **persistent injury issues**.
- **Total Appearances:** ~20

#### **7. FC Winterthur (Return, 2023–Present)**
- In **July 2023**, Kabashi returned to his **boyhood club, FC Winterthur**, now playing in the **Swiss Super League**.
- Signed a **two-year contract**, aiming to help the club avoid relegation.
- **2023–24 Season:** Played a **defensive midfield role**, contributing to Winterthur’s survival fight.

---
### **International Career**
Kabashi was eligible for both **Switzerland** and **Kosovo** due to his heritage.

#### **Switzerland Youth Teams**
- Represented **Switzerland at U-16, U-17, U-18, and U-19 levels**.
- Played in **UEFA European U-17 Championship qualifiers (2013)**.

#### **Kosovo Senior Team (2018–Present)**
- In **2018**, he switched allegiance to **Kosovo** (FIFA-approved switch).
- **Debut:** **March 24, 2018**, in a **friendly vs. Madagascar (1-0 win)**.
- **Competitive Debut:** **September 7, 2018**, in the **UEFA Nations League vs. Faroe Islands (2-0 win)**.
- **Total Caps (as of 2024):** **~15+**
- **Notable Matches:**
  - **2018–19 UEFA Nations League** (vs. Faroe Islands, Azerbaijan, Malta).
  - **2022 FIFA World Cup Qualifiers** (vs. Sweden, Spain, Greece).
  - **2022–23 UEFA Nations League** (vs. Cyprus, Greece).

---
### **Playing Style & Strengths**
- **Position:** Primarily a **defensive midfielder (CDM)**, but can play as a **central midfielder (CM)**.
- **Strengths:**
  - **Strong tackling & intercepting** (defensive awareness).
  - **Good passing range** (short and long balls).
  - **High work rate & stamina** (covers a lot of ground).
  - **Leadership qualities** (often a vocal presence in midfield).
- **Weaknesses:**
  - **Injury-prone** (has missed significant time due to fitness issues).
  - **Limited goal threat** (not a prolific scorer).

---
### **Honors & Achievements**
- **Liechtenstein Cup Winner (2021–22)** with **FC Vaduz**.
- **Swiss Challenge League Runner-up (2019–20)** with **FC Vaduz**.
- **UEFA Europa League appearances (2019, 2020)** with **FC Vaduz**.

---
### **Personal Life**
- Kabashi is of **Kosovar Albanian descent**, with family roots in **Kosovo**.
- Fluent in **German, Albanian, and English**.
- Known for his **professionalism and dedication** to the sport.

---
### **Current Status (2024)**
- **Club:** **FC Winterthur (Swiss Super League)**
- **Contract:** Until **June 2025**
- **National Team:** **Kosovo** (occasional call-ups)

---
### **Career Statistics (Approximate)**
| **Club**          | **Years**       | **Apps** | **Goals** | **Assists** |
|---------------------|----------------|---------|----------|------------|
| FC Winterthur       | 2013–2016, 2023– | ~70+    | ~5       | ~10        |
| FC Schaffhausen     | 2016–2017      | ~20     | ~1       | ~2         |
| FC Wil              | 2017–2019, 2022–23 | ~70  | ~5       | ~8         |
| FC Vaduz            | 2019–2021      | ~60     | ~3       | ~5         |
| FC Thun             | 2021–2022      | ~10     | ~0       | ~1         |
| **Total (Club)**    | **2013–2024**  | **~230+** | **~14**  | **~26**    |

| **National Team**   | **Years**       | **Apps** | **Goals** |
|----------------------|----------------|---------|----------|
| Switzerland (Youth)  | 2012–2015      | ~20     | ~1       |
| Kosovo               | 2018–Present   | ~15+    | ~0       |

---
### **Future Outlook**
- At **27 years old (2024)**, Kabashi is in his **prime years** but must **stay injury-free** to maximize his potential.
- Could earn more **Kosovo call-ups** if he performs well in the **Swiss Super League**.
- May explore **moves abroad** (e.g., Germany, Austria, or Turkey) if he seeks a new challenge.

---
### **Social Media & Public Presence**
- **Instagram:** [@arian_kabashi](https://www.instagram.com/arian_kabashi/) (occasional updates on career & personal life).
- **Low-key personality**, focuses more on football than media attention.

---
### **Fun Facts**
- Kabashi was **teammates with Xherdan Shaqiri** in Switzerland’s youth teams.
- He has played in **UEFA Europa League qualifiers** with **FC Vaduz**.
- Despite being a midfielder, he has **never scored for Kosovo’s senior team**.

---
### **Conclusion**
Arian Kabashi is a **hardworking, defensively solid midfielder** who has had a **steady career in Swiss football**. While not a superstar, he is a **reliable squad player** who can contribute at both **club and international levels**. His **leadership and experience** make him valuable, especially for **FC Winterthur and Kosovo**.
